**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in LPL exhibiting gain-of-function effects in patients with familial lipoprotein lipase deficiency, or loss-of-function effects in familial combined hyperlipidemia, LPL related, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: gnomAD analysis showing common variants with a minor allele frequency > 1% in the general population that are implicated as causal for either disease.)_
